name: duopore-public-learning-hours-allocation
description: Split your available study time across subjects while protecting the minimum time each needs.

interface.longDescription: Split your available study time across subjects while protecting the minimum time each needs. Enter weekly minutes, minimum time per subject and how important each subject is to you. See a whole-minute study plan that fits your time. For adults planning their own learning. If your minimums do not fit, the tool flags the gap rather than adding time you do not have.
defaultPrompt: Split my weekly study minutes across these subjects.
Can these minimum study times fit into my weekly budget?

positive.prompt: Use Learning Hours Allocation with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"weeklyMinutes":300,"subjects":[{"subject":"Statistics","minimumMinutes":60,"weight":2},{"subject":"Writing","minimumMinutes":30,"weight":1}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"300 weekly study minutes allocated exactly.","rows":[{"subject":"Statistics","protectedMinutes":60,"weight":2,"additionalMinutes":140,"totalMinutes":200,"displayHours":3.33},{"subject":"Writing","protectedMinutes":30,"weight":1,"additionalMinutes":70,"totalMinutes":100,"displayHours":1.67}],"warnings":["Weights and minimums are your priorities; this does not estimate mastery. Display hours are rounded; integer minutes are the exact budget."]}
